title: The condition is that the corresponding author of the article concerned is employed by ETH Zurich. Only charges for pure open-access journals will be covered.
main_content:
The condition is that the corresponding author of the article concerned is employed by ETH Zurich. Only charges for pure open-access journals will be covered.

When submitting the manuscript via the online form for the specific Wiley Open Access Journal choose ETH Zurich as institution from the drop-down menu.
